name: @foreverworks/mcps
description: MCP servers for Google Workspace, Notion, Romanian e-invoicing and company registers, open banking, invoicing, domains, Expo and more, on one shared toolkit

scripts.kit: npm run build -w @foreverworks/mcp-kit && npm run build -w @foreverworks/receipts
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && vitest run --config scripts/vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run check:personal-data && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:docs && npm run check:pack && npm run check:site
scripts.release:version: changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only && npm run build && tsx scripts/check-docs.ts --write

//: overrides: each one raises a transitive dependency whose parent pins a vulnerable version, and no release of the parent allows the fixed one (checked 2026-10-23).
multer: @bitwarden/cli pins 2.3.0 (GHSA-3pph-fpjx-jg34, fixed in 2.4.0); only its `bw serve` API uses it, which the bitwarden server never runs. Remove once @bitwarden/cli depends on multer >= 2.4.0.

tmp: external-editor 3.1.0 (its last release) wants tmp ^0.0.33 (GHSA-52f5-9888-hmc6, GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65, fixed in 0.2.6); it reaches us through @bitwarden/cli's pinned inquirer 8.2.6 and @anthropic-ai/mcpb's @inquirer/prompts 6. It only calls tmp.tmpNameSync, unchanged in 0.2. Remove once nothing depends on external-editor.
